newsitem.title: GERMANY: Prosecutors to decide on Daimler in coming weeks.
newsitem.headline: Prosecutors to decide on Daimler in coming weeks.

text.p: The Stuttgart public prosecutors' office said Tuesday it will decide next week whether to press charges against top executives at Daimler-Benz AG on allegations of violating securities laws.
The office said prosecutors were concluding their investigation of allegations against Daimler Chairman Juergen Schrempp and Chief Financial Officer Manfred Gentz.
The investigation was initiated by a Daimler shareholder-rights group, which accused the company of painting an overly rosy picture of its financial condition at the 1995 annual general meeting.
Daimler, which includes the Mercedes Benz car company, went on to record a 5.7 billion mark ($3.7 billion) loss tied to massive restructuring measures.
